# Tempo — Colosseum resource index

Every link below is copied verbatim from Colosseum's published corpus, including its curator caveats.

### Start here

**Network and funds**

- [Connection details](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/quickstart/connection-details)
  - Canonical mainnet and Moderato testnet chain IDs, RPC and WebSocket endpoints, and explorers. Confirm this page before copying network constants.
- [Getting funds](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/getting-funds)
  - Routes to production assets on mainnet and faucet assets on Moderato. Keep test faucet flows out of production UX.

**Application and contract stack**

- [EVM compatibility and differences](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/quickstart/evm-compatibility)
  - Read before porting an EVM app: no native gas token, unusual balance opcodes, selectable fee tokens, higher state-creation gas, and deterministic finality.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/sdk/typescript)
  - Official Viem-first setup for standard EVM actions plus Tempo transactions, batching, fee tokens, sponsorship, and testnet funding.
- [Accounts SDK](https://accounts.tempo.xyz/docs)
  - Account onboarding and signing adapters for Tempo Wallet, passkeys, Turnkey, Privy, private keys, and custom integrations.
- [Foundry on Tempo](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/sdk/foundry)
  - Current upstream Foundry workflow for Tempo projects, testing, deployment, verification, sponsorship, fee tokens, and nonce features.

### Build and control payments

**Core payment flows**

- [Send a payment](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/payments/send-a-payment)
  - Build TIP-20 transfers with memos and current Viem/Wagmi primitives. Verify the emitted recipient because a blocked transfer can succeed at the transaction level.
- [Accept a payment](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/payments/accept-a-payment)
  - Confirm incoming payments through balances or Transfer events using TypeScript, Rust, Python, or Go examples.
- [Tempo transactions](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/tempo-transaction)
  - Advanced transaction type for batching, fee sponsorship, fee-token selection, access keys, concurrent nonce lanes, and validity windows.

**Advanced payment controls**

- [Sponsor user fees](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/payments/sponsor-user-fees)
  - Integrate fee-payer flows and operational limits. The public sponsor is testnet-only; production use requires an approved hosted or self-managed payer.
- [Virtual addresses](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/payments/virtual-addresses)
  - Create distinct customer deposit addresses that forward TIP-20 funds to a master address. Advanced: balances stay at zero and address mining adds latency.
- [Receive policies](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/payments/configure-receive-policies)
  - Configure account-level inbound token controls and recovery. Advanced: blocked transfers can emit receipts instead of reverting, so index guard events.

### Issue and exchange payment tokens

**Token standards and liquidity**

- [TIP-20 overview](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/protocol/tip20/overview)
  - Tempo's payment-token standard: gas payment, transfer memos, lanes, role controls, receive policies, and stablecoin DEX integration.
- [Issue a stablecoin](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/issuance)
  - Create, migrate, mint, and administer a TIP-20 token. Treat mint, pause, freeze, and role authorities as production security decisions.
- [Stablecoin DEX](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/stablecoin-dex)
  - Integrate the protocol-level exchange for supported USD-denominated TIP-20 assets, including swaps and liquidity operations.

### Backend and automated services

**API and indexing**

- [Tempo API](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/api)
  - REST and RPC entry point for blocks, balances, tokens, transfers, transactions, webhooks, sponsorship, routes, and exchange data.
- [Indexer API](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/api/indexer-api)
  - Custom read-only SQL over hot PostgreSQL and archival ClickHouse data. Prefer stable REST endpoints for common reads and pin queried schemas.

**Machine payments**

- [Machine Payments Protocol](https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/machine-payments)
  - HTTP 402 payment challenges for API and agent services, with one-time charges and session-style payment flows. Advanced and still fast-moving.
